seoTitle: Get TradingView Premium Free: Legit Trials & Offers
metaDescription: Discover the official ways to access TradingView Premium for free in 2026, from trials to promotions, and how to avoid fake premium unlock scams.
intro: TradingView Premium unlocks extra indicators, advanced alerts, and additional chart layouts, but there are legitimate ways to try it before paying full price. This guide covers official free trials, promotional discounts, and referral programs, along with how to spot and avoid fake 'free premium' scams. It's aimed at active traders who want to explore premium tools responsibly.

steps.heading: Check if Premium can be used for free legally
steps.body: Look at TradingView's official pricing and promotions page to see current legitimate ways to access premium features without immediate payment.

steps.heading: Activate an official free trial
steps.body: Sign up through TradingView's site directly to unlock Premium features for the trial duration if one is currently offered.

steps.heading: Explore discounts and promotions
steps.body: Watch for seasonal discounts, referral programs, or promotional offers that can lower the cost of upgrading to Premium.

steps.heading: Avoid fake 'free premium' methods
steps.body: Steer clear of third-party sites or tools claiming to unlock Premium for free, as these are typically scams that can compromise your account.

steps.heading: Maximize features during the trial period
steps.body: Use your trial window to actively test multiple indicators, advanced alerts, and extra layouts so you can judge if Premium is worth it long term.

faq.question: Does TradingView offer a permanent free Premium tier?
faq.answer: No, Premium is a paid tier, and any free access typically comes through official time-limited trials or promotions rather than a permanent free option.

faq.question: Are referral programs a legitimate way to get discounts?
faq.answer: Yes, if TradingView offers an official referral program, using it as intended is a legitimate way to earn discounts or credits.

faq.question: How can I tell if a 'free premium' offer is a scam?
faq.answer: Be suspicious of any offer outside TradingView's official website or app, especially ones asking for account credentials or payment details upfront.

faq.question: What happens if I don't cancel before the trial ends?
faq.answer: You'll likely be charged automatically for the Premium plan once the trial period ends, so cancel beforehand if you don't want to continue.
